provenance.primary_source: CFPB/FFIEC HMDA public record 2025; data/application-outcomes-2025.json (applications acted on = actions 1-5)
provenance.dataset: loan_type=2 (FHA); action_taken in {1,2,3} = decisioned; reverse mortgages excluded

attribution.required_text: Source: FinanceRateCalc analysis of the public CFPB HMDA 2025 record; historical aggregate only.

reproduce.api: CFPB/FFIEC HMDA Data Browser API, no key
reproduce.filters: Keep loan_type=2 (FHA), action_taken in (1,2,3) as decisioned, reverse_mortgage != 1; denial = action_taken 3. The API has no reverse-mortgage filter: drop those rows yourself.
reproduce.note: outcome shares use action_taken 1-5 as the base; the denial rate uses 1-3
